name: Omaha hold 'em
summary: A community-card poker variant where each player gets four hole cards and must use exactly two with three board cards.
rules_text: Each player is dealt four private hole cards from a 52-card deck. Five community cards are dealt face up in stages (flop 3, turn 1, river 1) with betting rounds before the flop and after each stage. Players may check, bet, call, raise or fold in turn. At showdown, remaining players make the best five-card poker hand using exactly two cards from their hand and exactly three from the board. No playing four board cards, or one hole card. Highest standard poker hand wins the pot; if tied, split. Variants include pot-limit (PLO) and hi-lo split where a qualifying 8-or-better low hand splits the pot and different hole-card combos may be used for high and low.
